sets.notes: Set = every file of the install except the Inno Setup uninstaller pair, unins000.exe and unins000.dat, excluded because unins000.dat records the install itself and would make the id depend on the machine. The version 2.0 is the one Islepro.txt states (Islepro.txt:2); the projector's PE version resource (Macromedia Director Player 7.0.2r85) describes Director, not the game, and is not used as the game's version. Source: a third-party mirror (myabandonware.com), so the copy may differ from Soleau Software's own distribution. The sha256 of the downloaded installer file was not supplied and is not recorded here. runtime_writes is empty because this set lists every file as shipped. W3a (E001, F002) observed one runtime write, xtras/Isledft.dat, changed by the Save as default button of the Options screen; the successor set iwp-2.0-3694a782 declares it. xtras/Islepro.dat is still an unconfirmed candidate (not written in any E001 arm). Unregistered-build limit seen in the documents: the player plays Blue against three computer opponents (Islepro.txt:21-23 and :66-67); what registration unlocks beyond Islepro.txt:221-228 is unknown.

sets.notes: Set = every file of the archive islewr31.zip as acquired, 17 files, the three 1997-dated files included so that the id is reproducible from the same zip. The version 3.1 is the one the game's own documents state (ISLEWAR.DOC:6 "v3.1" and :11 "Version 3.1  Apr 1994"; FILE_ID.DIZ:1 and ISLE_REG.DOC:1 "v3.1"); the publisher's archived DOS page also heads its entry "ISLE WARS v3.1" (sources/web-soleau-dos-games.md, T05). Acquired from https://dosgames.com/files/islewr31.zip (216924 bytes, sha256 9789a8569104607e46df3e9b1992d24d4fc285957cd6fbad8b9d7cb32eb82812), linked from the game page https://dosgames.com/game/isle-wars/ as "DOWNLOAD 212k", which calls the game "Shareware ($15)"; downloaded and extracted with unzip on 2026-10-03 at 22:35 UTC. This is the shareware (unregistered) release: ISLEWAR.DOC:365 says the game is distributed as Shareware and ISLE_REG.DOC:7 names the $15.00 registration fee. dosgames.com is a third-party archive, so the copy may differ from Soleau Software's own distribution. AVEXTRA.TXT, OMBUDSMN.TXT and CATALOG.TXT are dated 1997 in the archive (the other fourteen files are dated 1994-04-01 12:00) and are not among the "Files Needed" of ISLEWAR.DOC:17-20; CATALOG.TXT:1 reads "As of August 1997", OMBUDSMN.TXT is an Association of Shareware Professionals ombudsman notice, AVEXTRA.TXT is a contact notice of Soleau Software. When they were made and who added them to this archive is unconfirmed. Archive timestamps are the dates of the files, not a release date, and not shown to be when the files were made. runtime_writes is empty because nothing has been observed; W3b measures it, and ISLEWAR.DAT (2048 bytes of comma-separated decimal text) has not been tested. Difference between registered and unregistered stated in the documents: the registered version greatly speeds up the loading and exiting of the program (ISLEWAR.DOC:370-371, ISLE_REG.DOC:8-9); what else registration unlocks is unknown.
